profile.insight: While archives document the post-hardcore supergroup Isles & Glaciers formed in 2008 and 19th-century Alpine glacier studies, no dance tradition named Glacier exists in the provided historical records.
profile.profile: the sources contain no records of a dance tradition called Glacier. Available documentation describes Isles & Glaciers, an American post-hardcore supergroup formed in 2008, as well as historical literary and geological references to natural ice glaciers in Alaska, the Sierra Nevada, and Switzerland. Consequently, no movement patterns, performance practices, or choreographic contexts exist in the source material for a dance by this name.
profile.profile_long:
### Origins and History
No historical origin or developmental timeline for a dance called Glacier is contained in the sources. The source material references the musical band Isles & Glaciers, formed in 2008 as an American post-hardcore supergroup featuring musicians such as Craig Owens, Jonny Craig, Vic Fuentes, Nick Martin, Brian Southall, Matt Goddard, and Mike Fuentes. Their debut EP, *The Hearts of Lonely People*, was recorded in Seattle, Washington, between December 3 and December 13, 2008, and released on March 9, 2010. Additional sources document literal ice formations, including a 1904 account of glaciers in Resurrection Bay, Alaska, a 1910 story regarding a Sierra Nevada glacier, and a 1913 report from Berne, Switzerland, concerning the recession of twenty-nine Alpine crest glaciers during the nineteenth century. No dance history is recorded.

### Music and Instruments
No traditional dance music is described for Glacier. In popular music, the supergroup Isles & Glaciers produced post-hardcore and progressive rock music featuring three distinct vocalists (Jonny Craig, Craig Owens, Vic Fuentes) utilizing clean singing and screamings, accompanied by rhythm guitar, lead guitar, bass guitar, drums, synthesizers, and keyboards.

claims.text: Isles & Glaciers was an American post-hardcore supergroup formed in 2008.
claims.quote: Isles & Glaciers was an American post-hardcore supergroup formed in 2008.

claims.text: The band recorded material for their debut EP in Seattle between December 3 and December 13, 2008.
claims.quote: They recorded material for their debut EP, The Hearts of Lonely People December 3–13, 2008 in Seattle, Washington and again in April 2009.

claims.text: The band played their first and only scheduled live show on March 21, 2009 at Emo's Bar in Austin, Texas during SXSW.
claims.quote: Isles & Glaciers played their first and only scheduled live show on March 21, 2009, which was presented by Alternative Press at Emo's Bar in Austin, Texas for a free show during SXSW.

claims.text: Isles & Glaciers played a blend of post-hardcore and progressive rock music featuring vocal switches among three singers.
claims.quote: Isles & Glaciers, welche aus den Musikern von Emarosa, Dance Gavin Dance, Chiodos, D.R.U.G.S. und Pierce the Veil bestand, spielte eine Mischung aus Post-Hardcore und progressiver Rockmusik.
